acquisition: Actual GitHub rendered preview and real Copy code to clipboard buttons via existing browser API; no installer invocation

codes.text:
# Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell.exe), or supported PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe)
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theislampill/salah_widget/main/install.ps1 | iex

paragraphs: The Windows response-string command executes the downloaded text in the host where you paste it. Windows PowerShell 5.1 is the declared minimum; the retained PowerShell 7 qualification is version 7.6.6. The commands below use one selected host. Your execution policy still applies; a policy refusal is not installation.

If you configured the widget in the builder, Install widget carries its encoded settings through SALAH_WIDGET_HASH into the preset iframe. For a reviewed local-file invocation, keep that environment value, or pass -WidgetHash on Windows, if you want the same configuration.

The wizard downloads and stages files, offers clipboard paths and opens the browser's manual pages. Extension installation and preset import remain manual; it does not silently install extensions or write to browser extension storage. Importing the preset replaces your current TablissNG dashboard with the widget layout. Precise in-widget location also needs the iframe's allow="geolocation"; hosts may strip it, while coarse auto-detect still works.
These examples download the installer at a pinned source commit. Read it, use the optional offline preview, then run normal mode when ready:

On Windows, Invoke-WebRequest -OutFile keeps the downloaded file bytes. Review with Get-Content -LiteralPath; do not resave the file through Get-Content/Set-Content or change its encoding. Choose either host below:

For the supported PowerShell 7 host, replace the two powershell.exe calls with pwsh.exe -NoProfile -File ".\install.ps1" -DryRun and pwsh.exe -NoProfile -File ".\install.ps1". Run one host's normal command.
With reviewed local files, -DryRun performs offline local discovery and prints planned actions. Preview creates no staging or usable artifacts and is neither installation nor staged completion.
